claims.statement: VCR (Video Cassette Recorder) is the HTTP interaction recording and playback mechanism used in LangChain integration tests. Tests record live API interactions once with VCR, which scrubs sensitive headers and secrets before saving the cassette; subsequent runs replay cassettes instead of making live calls, enabling fast deterministic testing without credentials in CI.

Cassettes are stored in `tests/cassettes/` at the package root or in module-specific subdirectories like `tests/integration_tests/chat_models/cassettes/test_base/`. The `vcr_cassette_dir` fixture dynamically computes the correct cassette directory per test module.

LangChain scrubs sensitive data from cassettes before saving via multi-layer redaction: request/response headers (authorization, cookies, organization headers) are replaced with PLACEHOLDER; request/response bodies undergo recursive JSON parsing to redact OAuth secret fields (access_token, refresh_token, etc.) and JWT-shaped strings; binary payloads (PNG, JPEG, PDF) are skipped for performance since JWTs are ASCII.

Integration tests load credentials from `.env` files (located at `tests/.env` or `tests/integration_tests/.env`) via `dotenv.load_dotenv()` in conftest on import. Tests access credentials via `os.environ["API_KEY"]`. Tests without an API key in `.env` fail at runtime if they attempt to make live API calls, but cassette-backed tests run without credentials.

Integration tests use pytest markers to classify test types: @pytest.mark.vcr marks cassette-backed tests that replay recorded interactions (run in CI with --record-mode=none); @pytest.mark.scheduled marks live-API-only tests that are skipped in CI unless running in a scheduled workflow; unmarked tests are offline and don't require credentials.

Cassettes are recorded once via `pytest --record-mode=new_episodes` with a valid API key in `.env`. VCR intercepts HTTP calls, scrubs sensitive data via before_record hooks, serializes to compressed YAML (.yaml.gz), and saves relative to the test module. Cassettes are committed to the repository and replayed in CI with --record-mode=none.

Integration tests support parameterized testing of multiple models/configurations via @pytest.mark.parametrize. Each parameter combination generates a separate cassette file (e.g., test_invoke[model0].yaml.gz, test_invoke[model1].yaml.gz), allowing independent recorded interactions for different model variants.

VCR integration tests support both sync and async code; async tests use @pytest.mark.vcr and work identically to sync tests because VCR intercepts the underlying httpx/requests library. Streaming tests (via stream() or stream_events()) are fully supported; VCR records the stream sequence and replays it identically.

Each package's conftest.py extends base VCR configuration (from langchain_tests.conftest.base_vcr_config) via a vcr_config() fixture. Configuration includes record_mode (once/new_episodes/none), match_on strategy (method/uri/body or json_body for JSON-ignoring-order matching), filter_headers, before_record hooks, serializer (yaml.gz), and custom matchers registered in pytest_recording_configure().

OpenAI Codex tests require special VCR handling in CI: conftest.py skips Codex tests at collection time unless running in --record-mode=none (cassette playback), and uses monkeypatch to stub _FileChatGPTOAuthTokenProvider token methods with fake in-memory tokens for VCR playback without requiring on-disk OAuth files.

LangChain integration tests can be run in multiple modes via pytest record-mode flags: --record-mode=once (default, records new cassettes, replays existing); --record-mode=new_episodes (always records, overwrites existing cassettes); --record-mode=none (playback-only, fails if cassette missing, used in CI).

LangChain partner packages inherit a standard suite of integration tests via ChatModelIntegrationTests from langchain_tests.integration_tests. Partner test classes override properties (chat_model_class, chat_model_params, supports_* and has_* feature declarations) and may override test methods for provider-specific behavior (audio inputs, reasoning models). Each inherited test method is pre-marked with @pytest.mark.vcr; cassettes are generated automatically and named with test method names, optionally parameterized (test_invoke[model0].yaml.gz). This ensures all partners maintain consistent test coverage and automatically receive new tests when the standard suite is updated.

LangChain integration tests use three pytest markers to classify test types: @pytest.mark.vcr marks cassette-backed tests that replay recorded interactions (run in PR checks with --record-mode=none); @pytest.mark.scheduled marks live-API-only tests that are skipped in regular CI but run in scheduled daily workflows with real credentials; unmarked tests are offline and don't require credentials.

VCR (Video Cassette Recorder) records HTTP interactions during test execution: in recording phase, the test runs with a valid API key and --record-mode=once/new_episodes, VCR intercepts HTTP calls, scrubbing functions redact sensitive headers (authorization, cookies, organization) and OAuth secret fields in request/response bodies, then the cassette is saved as compressed YAML (.yaml.gz) and committed to git. In playback phase, VCR loads the cassette and replays pre-recorded responses without making live calls or requiring credentials.

LangChain scrubs sensitive data from cassettes via multi-layer redaction before recording: request/response headers (authorization, openai-organization, cookies, set-cookie, chatgpt-account-id) are replaced with **REDACTED**; request/response bodies undergo recursive JSON parsing to redact OAuth secret fields (access_token, refresh_token, id_token, code, device_code, client_secret, code_verifier) and JWT-shaped strings; binary payloads (PNG, JPEG, PDF, audio) are skipped for performance since JWTs and OAuth secrets are ASCII-only.

LangChain partner packages inherit a standard suite of integration tests via ChatModelIntegrationTests from langchain_tests.integration_tests. Partner test classes override required properties (chat_model_class, chat_model_params) and feature-declaration properties (has_tool_calling, supports_image_inputs, supports_json_mode, etc.) to specify which capabilities to test. Each inherited test method is pre-marked with @pytest.mark.vcr; cassettes are generated automatically with names like test_invoke.yaml.gz or TestOpenAIStandard.test_invoke[model0].yaml.gz. This ensures all partners maintain consistent test coverage and automatically receive new tests when the standard suite is updated.

Each package's conftest.py extends base VCR configuration from langchain_tests.conftest.base_vcr_config via a vcr_config() fixture. Configuration includes record_mode (once/new_episodes/none), match_on strategy (method/uri/body or custom json_body for JSON-ignoring-order matching), filter_headers, before_record hooks (remove_request_headers, remove_response_headers), serializer (yaml.gz), and custom matchers registered in pytest_recording_configure().

Pull request CI via check_diffs.yml runs _compile_integration_test.yml to validate integration tests compile without syntax or import errors via pytest -m compile, catching issues before test execution. This is a fast check that runs for every package with changed files.

Pull request CI via check_diffs.yml runs _test_vcr.yml to execute cassette-backed integration tests in playback-only mode (--record-mode=none), requiring no API keys and no live calls. If a cassette is missing or request bodies don't match, the test fails immediately. This catches stale cassettes caused by test code changes.

Scheduled integration tests (integration_tests.yml) run daily or on-demand with live API credentials from GitHub secrets. Only tests marked @pytest.mark.scheduled run in these workflows; VCR-marked tests are skipped. The workflow computes a dynamic test matrix for affected partner packages and runs make integration_tests, which smoke-tests each supported SDK major version.

Cassettes are stored in module-specific subdirectories like tests/integration_tests/chat_models/cassettes/test_base/ or tests/cassettes/ at the package root. The vcr_cassette_dir fixture computes the correct directory per test module. For parameterized tests, cassette names include parameter identifiers (e.g., test_invoke[model0].yaml.gz, test_invoke[model1].yaml.gz).

VCR matches requests during cassette replay using configurable strategies: default is [method, uri, body]; OpenAI tests use custom json_body matcher that parses both bodies as JSON and compares parsed trees, ignoring whitespace and key order. Custom matchers can be registered via pytest_recording_configure() to implement provider-specific matching logic.

VCR integration tests support both sync and async code identically; async tests work because VCR intercepts the underlying httpx/requests library. Streaming tests via stream() or stream_events() are fully supported; VCR records the stream sequence and replays it identically on playback.

OpenAI Codex tests require special VCR handling in CI: conftest.py uses pytest_collection_modifyitems() to skip Codex tests at collection time unless running in --record-mode=none (cassette playback), and uses an autouse fixture to monkeypatch _FileChatGPTOAuthTokenProvider token methods with fake in-memory tokens for VCR playback without requiring on-disk OAuth files.
